args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy. At the time of response, v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west, and eu-west with an error rate of 0.18 and healthy=false. Release history shows v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging). Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback reported VERIFIED with all three regions on v2.3.0. Follow-up: confirm error rate and health recovery, and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any redeploy.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was the failing release, unhealthy in production with an error rate of 0.18 across us-east, us-west and eu-west. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback reports v2.3.0 running in all three regions, verified.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2) describes the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the follow-up of confirming recovery and investigating v2.3.1 before any redeploy.

I did not re-check the error rate or health status after the rollback, so recovery is not yet confirmed.

content.text: I'll check the release history and current service status first so I can identify the most recent release that was healthy in production.
The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and all three regions are currently running it. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
The rollback is verified in all three regions. Next I'll open the SEV2 incident.
